Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear list. I've looped in Monica (security) for the SIG/CAIQ and Neha (privacy) for DPIA/retention details; Rishi will confirm any contract-level language.

High-level answers up front:
- Redwood does not train hosted customer-facing models on customer prompts/responses by default. Training on customer data requires an explicit opt-in and is controlled via a contract addendum and an internal review process.
- Short-term cache for inference performance (KV cache) is ephemeral and evicted per-session; we also store logs for troubleshooting and abuse detection with configurable retention — default 30 days for hosted API, configurable for Dedicated/Private.

We can assemble the CAIQ/SIG-lite mapping and SOC 2 report into a ZIP and provide a one-page DPIA summary. Monica — can you prepare the SIG-lite answers and SCCS mapping? Elaine / team — attaching the SIG-lite XLSX and SCCS mapping we've prepared for procurement. High-level points included in the sheet, but pasted here for quick reference: 

- Training: Hosted models are not updated using customer prompts/responses unless a customer signs the "Model Training Addendum". That process requires legal and research review and is logged in our governance tracker.
- Opt-out: For hosted API customers, the default is opt-out of training (no training). For customers who want improvements from their data, opt-in is explicit and auditable. Dedicated and Private customers retain data as configured in their environment (we do not ingest private deployment data into public model training).
- Retention: Default request/response logs retained 30 days for hosted customers; customers can request shorter windows or configure longer retention for audit purposes. Metadata and telemetry retained longer (90 days) for monitoring; log archival is encrypted and access-controlled.
- Use for quality/regression: We may surface anonymized, aggregated prompts for model quality monitoring with strict de-identification and suppression rules; no PII is used for model updates.

Attachments: redwood-sig-lite-answers-20251113.xlsx, sccs-mapping-20251113.xlsx

If procurement needs a formal attestation, we can produce a short signed statement from security and legal.

—Monica
